## Company Description
SoleChem Europe S.r.l. is a global b2b chemical distributor & manufacturer supplying 4,483+ high-purity chemical products to customers in over 50+ countries worldwide. Specializing in polyurethane systems, adhesives, paints, coatings, and industrial raw materials with certified quality.
